module: Flowgraph node "Career Vehicle Select" (behaviour once + singleActive, depends on core_input_bindings). Opens the career menu 'menu.careerVehicleSelect' where the player chooses among 3 vehicles, to test or pick them. Inputs: flow, reset (impulse), description (string or translation table), and for each vehicle i=1..3: vehNimage, vehNname, vehNbrand, vehNdesc, vehNtestDisabled. Flow outputs (only one is true depending on the button): test1, pick1, test2, pick2, test3, pick3. The UI buttons call the node back via a generated Lua command (getCmd).
notes: _executionStarted is defined twice; the second definition overwrites the first and does not reset open/done.
The functions closed() and started() exist but are not called in this file (they may be called from the UI).
The output pin "flow" is used by started() whereas the schema declares no output pin named flow (apart from the implicit flow).

init.desc: Sets open and done to false.

_executionStarted.desc: When the graph starts: sets all outputs to false and _active to false.

_executionStopped.desc: Closes the window if it is open then reset().

reset.desc: Sets done, open and _active back to false.

buttonPushed.desc: Called by the UI: sets to true only the output pin bearing the action's name (test1, pick2...).

getCmd.desc: Builds the Lua command that the UI button will run to call buttonPushed back on this node.

action.desc: name of the pin to activate

returns.desc: Lua code to run on the GE side

closeDialogue.desc: Marks the window as closed and inactive.

openDialogue.desc: Builds the data of the 3 vehicles (image, brand, name, description, button codes, testDisabled) and navigates to 'menu.careerVehicleSelect'.

closed.desc: Marks the choice as finished (done) and inactive.

started.desc: Closes the window, sets the output flow pin to true and done to true.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: sets open and _active back to false at the client-side end of mission.

work.desc: If reset is active: closes, resets and sets the outputs to false. Otherwise, opens the window once when flow is active and it is not already done.
